suggestions.quote: Michel Siffre came out of a cave with no clock 25 days behind the calendar (c16).
suggestions.fix: Michel Siffre came out of a cave with no clock after about two months, 25 days behind the calendar (c16).

suggestions.quote: The thousand isn't ours. An economist who studies uploaded minds, Robin Hanson, guessed one would run about a thousand times human speed (c07). A year is 8,760 hours (c03). At a thousand times: one night.
suggestions.fix: The thousand isn't ours. An economist who studies uploaded minds, Robin Hanson, guessed one would run about a thousand times human speed (c07). A year is 8,760 hours (c03). At a thousand times, that fits into about eight and three-quarter hours: one night.

suggestions.quote: The hard ones take about 2,200 class hours at the US diplomats' school (c26). You've had seven years of evenings. Four languages, at a working level.
suggestions.fix: The hard ones take an English speaker about 2,200 class hours at the US diplomats' school (c26). You've had seven years of evenings. Four languages, at a working level.

keep.quote: Out there a close friend takes more than 200 hours together (c23). In here, that's about twelve minutes of her evening.
People dropped 31 metres into a net later judged their own fall 36% longer than other people's (c18). A moment is as long as the memory it leaves.
Sleep is when the brain files the day (c14). And one small, famous experiment, in 1924, decided that forgetting is mostly the new rubbing out the old (c13).
